mapper.select:
SELECT id, username, name, gender, phone, id_card, driving_years, photo_url, is_banned, average_rating, rating_count, create_time, update_time FROM driver
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY name

SELECT dt.truck_type_id, tt.type_name, tt.capacity, tt.description, tt.base_fare,
v.id AS vehicle_id, v.license_plate_number, v.vehicle_brand FROM driver_truck_type dt JOIN truck_type tt ON dt.truck_type_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN vehicle v ON dt.driver_id = v.driver_id AND dt.truck_type_id = v.truck_type_id WHERE dt.driver_id = #{driverId}
